trossos.en: Panteres Grogues is a Barcelona sports club founded in 1994, a leading name in LGBTQ+ visibility in sport and the first club of its kind created in Spain. It is a non-profit based in the Eixample, with around 1,500 members and some 25 sports sections, basketball among them.

trossos.context: etiqueta per a lectors de pantalla

trossos.ca:
Panteres Grogues forma part de l'ecosistema de
    partners i col·laboradors que fan possible el CB Grup Barna, el club de bàsquet base del Clot,
    Barcelona. Segueix-los: cada follow que reben des del club forma part del que els oferim a canvi.
trossos.en: Panteres Grogues is part of the ecosystem of partners and collaborators that make CB Grup Barna possible, the youth basketball club of the Clot, Barcelona. Follow them: every follow they get through the club is part of what we offer them in return.

trossos.ca: Oferta per a la família del Barna
Panteres Grogues encara no té cap avantatge publicat per a la família del Barna. Si en vols oferir un, escriu-nos i el publiquem aquí.
trossos.en: Panteres Grogues does not yet have any offer published for Barna families. If you would like to offer one, write to us and we will publish it here.
